diagnosed_bottlenecks: mine_signals.py returned unrelated GitHub mega-issues because target keywords were not restricted with in:title and Algolia HN queries used unsupported OR groups.
Reddit public search JSON returned HTTP 403 Blocked.
Mining multiple targets required separate CLI calls and GitHub reactions crowded out HN results.
Stages 2-4 lacked a single deterministic verification and packaging command before Gate 2.
upgrades_implemented: Upgraded scripts/mine_signals.py with --targets batching, in:title + alias filtering, HN split story queries, gzip-aware Stack Exchange API integration replacing Reddit 403, and balanced per-source capping (ceil(limit/2)).
Created scripts/ship_check.py to validate SPEC.md/landing.html/LAUNCH_KIT.md placeholders, run all project tests, and build clean dist/<slug>-v0.1.0.zip bundles.
kaizen_log.expected_impact: Fewer LLM turns, zero wasted tokens on noisy signals, reliable 3-source signal diversity, and autonomous Stage 2-4 QA before Gate 2.

diagnosed_bottlenecks: Wiring live checkout URLs and product IDs into landing pages and extension/CLI source required manual multi-file edits before re-packaging.
Single-product launches left Average Order Value (AOV) on the table without a cross-product bundle storefront or unified operator go-live checklist.
upgrades_implemented: Created scripts/configure_checkout.py to inject live checkout URLs & product IDs and automatically re-run ship_check.py --package.
Created scripts/build_portfolio.py to generate launch_hub/index.html ($49 All-Access Bundle storefront) and launch_hub/MASTER_LAUNCH_PLAYBOOK.md directly from pipeline/state.json.
kaizen_log.expected_impact: One-command checkout wiring and higher AOV via a multi-product bundle storefront with minimal operator effort.

diagnosed_bottlenecks: License clients checked a single productId string, blocking $49 All-Access Bundle keys from unlocking individual apps.
IDE/CLI scaffolds and ship_check.py did not enforce host-ecosystem runtime manifests (engines.vscode + contributes.commands, [project.scripts]).
mine_signals.py was biased toward developer forums (HN/GitHub/SO) and lacked B2B SaaS power-user pain signals.
Landing pages and license clients had no zero-backend funnel or paywall telemetry hooks.
upgrades_implemented: Upgraded templates/license-validator/license_client.js and .py (and synced all 3 projects) to accept array/CSV productIds and added configure_checkout.py --bundle-product-id.

Added VS Code ExtensionContext manifest/command registration to vscode-workspace-profile-config and scaffold_project.py, [project.scripts] to cli-wrapper projects, and ecosystem manifest checks to ship_check.py.
Added B2B-WebApps Stack Exchange miner (--source b2b) and expanded B2B SaaS target aliases in scripts/mine_signals.py.
Added local paywall_hits / activation_attempts / pro_activations telemetry to license clients and data-fk-cta click hooks to landing page templates and launch_hub.
kaizen_log.expected_impact: Seamless $49 bundle key unlocking, marketplace-ready VS Code/CLI builds, higher-WTP B2B signal discovery, and zero-backend funnel conversion visibility.

diagnosed_bottlenecks: Store onboarding (Lemon Squeezy business-intent) blocked without a live public website URL, downloadable artifacts, and support/refund policies.
Configuring checkout URLs did not automatically regenerate static GitHub Pages files.
upgrades_implemented: Upgraded scripts/build_portfolio.py to emit a static GitHub Pages site in docs/ (.nojekyll, index.html, products/<slug>/index.html, downloads/*.zip, and Lemon Squeezy-compliant support/14-day refund/privacy sections).
Upgraded scripts/configure_checkout.py with --bundle-url and automatic launch_hub/ + docs/ sync after every checkout update.
kaizen_log.expected_impact: Instant free GitHub Pages storefront ready for Lemon Squeezy verification and zero-friction updates when live checkout links are added.

diagnosed_bottlenecks: Lemon Squeezy redirected onboarding to Stripe Managed Payments (2025-03-31.basil), which requires Checkout Sessions (managed_payments[enabled]=true), success/cancel pages, and webhook/session verification.
Existing license clients lacked Stripe Checkout Session key (cs_test_.../cs_live_...) support.
upgrades_implemented: Created scripts/stripe_managed_payments.py with provision, create-session, and serve (POST /create-checkout-session 303 redirect, POST /verify-license, POST /webhook).
Added Stripe provider & cs_test_/cs_live_ auto-detection to templates/license-validator/license_client.js and .py (synced across all 3 projects).
Upgraded scripts/build_portfolio.py to generate Stripe success.html (?session_id= license display + Copy button) and cancel.html into launch_hub/ and GitHub Pages docs/.
kaizen_log.expected_impact: Seamless drop-in migration from Lemon Squeezy to Stripe Managed Payments with Merchant-of-Record tax compliance across 80+ countries.

diagnosed_bottlenecks: Static landing pages without a live try-before-install tool hurt conversion and fail Show HN 'interactive thing you can play with' guidelines.
VS Code and Python CLI projects only shipped raw .zip files instead of native .vsix and PEP 427 .whl packages.
upgrades_implemented: Upgraded scripts/ship_check.py to build VS Code .vsix archives and PEP 427 .whl wheels alongside .zip bundles.
Added a 3-tab zero-install Interactive Live Playground (#playground) plus .vsix and pip install .whl links to scripts/build_portfolio.py.
Updated .agents/skills/stage-4-launch-and-monetize/SKILL.md to gate Show HN on interactive playgrounds and enforce native packaging.
kaizen_log.expected_impact: Higher visitor-to-buyer conversion via live browser demos and frictionless 1-command installs via .vsix / pip install.
